_about: PARKED. What each face button holds in each stance (Game Design's matrix, docs/design/melee-press-feel.md sections 10, 11 and 13): X quick, Y strong, A the stance's context action (a press and a hold), B its signature. X, Y and B each read three ways: speed, tech, heavy. A filter is part values that must all hold; any is a list of filters of which one must. needs lists what a cell asks of others before it can play
_spread: each pick marks down the shapes that share its path, its target or its tip, and more those that share limb, path and target, so a cell spreads over the grammar

x.what: light strikes: the light, the flurry blow, the skill strike, the juggle strike
x._quotas: filled in this order before the cell is filled freely. The first five are the stick's leans (a weight of 3 at run time, not a filter). The last two keep both readings deep: a juggle is up to 5 skill strikes (Orb)

y.what: heavy strikes: the guard breaker, the lift, the ender; a fully held lone heavy may launch (Orb)

held: his channel (On the Chin for the rival)

needs.what: contextHeld; the aimed throw as a knock-back; the grab lockout of 90 ticks
a second look for each grab and throw (wave 4's grabs: designed, not posed)

b.what: his defining signature, a melee art. The kinds are proposed and not final, so the frame is generic and nothing is hand-picked

slots.from: a lunge from the mid band; nothing in reach

readings.tech: the quick form on his beat, closing a string

b.legal: a person screens the frame and its hand-picked piece (docs/legal/movegen-screen.md section 3)

x.what: the zip strike from the mid band (20 ki), the step strike in reach (5 ki), a piloted light charge from far; in reach with the stick away, the zip away

needs.what: the zip as a move: in, the blow, out; its ki; the floor on its travel ticks; where it ends by the stick
the step strike: a light at 0.8 with a step of up to 2 bh, and the slip when it lands in the rival's tell
the dash, the fade and the lane step played at zip speed, drawn the whole way; a pass to the far side
the zip's blur by reading: the smear, the sharp echoes, the squash

y.what: the zip heavy from the mid band (30 ki), a heavy on the move in reach (10 ki), a piloted heavy charge, and the pursuit past charge range

needs.what: the zip heavy (no lift: he is leaving), the heavy on the move, the pursuit
as X

pressed: a snatch on the fly (pick-up, civilian)
held: the zip tackle from the mid band (25 ki)

needs.what: the snatch on the fly; the zip tackle
the tackle, the lift and the throw are posed (pair2); the snatch is not

b.what: his signature as a zip; held, a terrain art. It differs for each fighter (Orb), and the kinds are not final, so the frame is generic

readings.speed: the quick form, as a zip

b.legal: a person screens the frame and each fighter's version; a terrain art is a new set piece

x.what: bolts: the spray (speed), the measured bolt (tech), the volley of three (heavy)

needs.what: the volley: three bolts in a tight fan as one press
each fighter's bolt in his own family; no ball in the palm

y.what: the heavy shot (speed, tech), the charged shot and the short beam (heavy), and for the rival the split on a second press

needs.what: the short beam as a shot kind; the split (SimShots.split) for the rival
a braced pose for the short beam; the split's second release
the short beam and the split, in each fighter's family

held: an aimed mine, lobbed up to 6 bh

needs.what: the aimed mine; the long shove
the mine lay and the shove are posed (energy1, rival3); the aimed lob of a mine is not

b.what: the beam, as built: the biome variants, the beam struggle and the beam answers
b.legal: screened as built; a new variant or a new hand is new vocabulary

x.what: the check, a short blow from behind the guard: mashed (speed), the parry when timed after a blocked blow (tech), the guard strike when held (heavy)

needs.what: the check (half a light, 6 ticks, once in 20), the parry (the rival reels 12), the guard strike
the guard layer a check is thrown over: the other arm stays set
the parry's mark

y.what: the push: 3 bh and short shoves (speed), the stuff inside the rival's tell (tech), the long push of 5 bh (heavy). No damage

needs.what: the push (no damage, 10-tick wind-up, 3 bh; 5 bh held), the short shove, the stuff
a pushed fighter's slide back is posed (s3.shoved); the push itself reuses strike key sets with no impact snap

pressed: the reversal after a block (20 ki)
held: the aimed deflect at range (10 ki)

needs.what: the guard throw; the aimed deflect
the reversal and the swat are posed (step3, energy1); the guard throw is not

b.what: a counter: he sets himself, catches the next blow and answers it. It differs for each fighter (Orb), and the kinds are not final, so the frame is generic
b.legal: a person screens the frame and each fighter's version: the rival catches on his plates, the Protagonist turns it aside with open hands

x.what: his quick special: as authored (speed), on its mark (tech), its charged cut (heavy)

needs.what: which special sits on which button; the Protagonist's specials
each special's cuts: none is posed as a whole
a special's charged cut and its mark

y.what: his strong special, in the same three readings

a.what: his utility special: pressed, and its held cut

b.what: his release; in acts 3 and 4, held to full, his ultimate (75 ki)
b.legal: a person screens it: the charge pose and the release are where the stacking rule bites
